All edits verified. Here is the structured report:

### SUMMARY
Applied light-mode Tailwind variants to all three admin Vue files. For each file, every template class that was hardcoded for dark mode was supplemented with a `dark:` counterpart and a matching light-mode value per the 17 transformation rules plus 3 special-case rules. Settings.vue received 11 edits, profile.vue 5 edits, and posts.vue 14 edits (including the sticky-column `bg-[#121214]` and gradient fix in the script section). Purple-button `text-white` was preserved; the upload button was rewritten per the special button rule; the RichEditor container was updated per its special rule. No remaining dark-only patterns were detected in the template sections.

### EVIDENCE
- `app/pages/admin/settings.vue`: confirmed lines 5, 12, 46, 70, 96, 100-101, 107, 118, 128, 139, 197 updated (read final template 1-218)
- `app/pages/admin/profile.vue`: confirmed lines 5-6, 10, 29, 39, 49, 54 updated (read final template 1-64)
- `app/pages/admin/posts.vue`: confirmed lines 5-6, 16, 25, 42, 67, 87, 122-123, 145, 162, 304, 327, 426-427 updated (read final template 1-350 and columns 420-431)
- `grep_files` sweeps for `text-gray-400`, `text-gray-300`, `bg-[#121214]`, `border-gray-800`, `border-gray-700`, `hover:text-white`, `hover:bg-gray-800` all returned only already-patched lines
- `grep_files` for `ring-1 ring-gray-800` and `divide-gray-800` returned zero matches (rules not applicable)

### CHANGES
- `app/pages/admin/settings.vue` — h1 `text-white` → `text-gray-900 dark:text-white`
- `app/pages/admin/settings.vue` — subtitle `text-gray-400` → `text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400`

- `app/pages/admin/profile.vue` — form separator `border-t border-gray-800/50` → `border-t border-gray-200 dark:...`
- `app/pages/admin/posts.vue` — h1 `text-white` → `text-gray-900 dark:text-white`
- `app/pages/admin/posts.vue` — subtitle `text-gray-400` → `text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400`
- `app/pages/admin/posts.vue` — main container `bg-[#121214] border border-gray-800/50` → light/dark
- `app/pages/admin/posts.vue` — image cell `border border-gray-800 bg-gray-900` → light/dark
- `app/pages/admin/posts.vue` — title cell `text-white` → `text-gray-900 dark:text-white`
- `app/pages/admin/posts.vue` — views cell `text-gray-400` → `text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400`
- `app/pages/admin/posts.vue` — createdAt cell `text-gray-400` → `text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400`

None.
